name: design-promax-style-presets
description: Feel/theme presets. Default clean_product = Vault OTP case study. Routing picks surface; style locks quality.

efficient_read.description: Prefer these 3 files for clean_product UI. Only add route App.tsx if shell differs (sidebar/chat/checkout).
efficient_read.merge_rule: If style is clean_product or trust_green or clean_product_compact: start from clean_product_core (3), add at most 1 route-specific App.tsx if surface needs chat/sidebar/table/checkout shell. Skip secondary unless atom missing. Cap 4. If style is workstation_dense or dense_admin: files = style.must_read (cap 4), no extra shell App.

clean_product.label: Clean product (Vault OTP quality)
clean_product.when: Default for product UIs, dapps, vaults, settings tools. Prefer unless campaign landing or dense admin.

primary_color.note: Soft green trust; radial washes ok, no purple AI full-bleed

copy_rules: No contract address footers unless user asked
No chain-name or truncated-address chips in chrome
anti_patterns: Purple full-bleed AI marketing for product apps
Default square buttons when pill CTAs expected
More than one primary filled CTA per card
Landing and desk jammed on one page
Second Connect button when navbar already has Connect
Engineering chips (chain name, truncated vault, Pre-flight)
Fake ACME footer / newsletter / social to #

clean_product_compact.label: Clean product compact (mobile-first)
clean_product_compact.when: Mobile-first, tight screens, hide feature marketing row

trust_green.label: Trust green (finance / security)
trust_green.when: Finance, security, vault, savings, compliance-feeling product
trust_green.notes: Same structure as clean_product; force green primary tokens and security icons (shield, lock, key).

marketing_campaign.label: Marketing campaign
marketing_campaign.when: Landing, pricing, launch - not logged-in product shell
section_recipe: hero: solid headline full job line + 2 CTAs
how it works (3 FeatureCards as steps)
marketing_campaign.hero_override:
Source headline uses bg-clip-text gradient +
. Use text-foreground text-balance, no
, clamp(40px,8vw,64px), tracking-tight

cta_pair.secondary: variant="bordered" radius="full" border-default-200 with arrow in a rounded-full bg-default-100 circle

marketing_campaign.notes:
Still pill CTAs and solar icons. Never put Connect on the landing. Never fade or
-chop hero type. Never skip Features. Features != How it works. Same full job line on landing and desk. Never ship ACME newsletter footer. If the product also has work to do, pair with a /desk route (clean_product) - see landing-and-desk.md.

dense_admin.label: Dense admin / data
dense_admin.notes: Keep card borders and full-radius CTAs; allow sidebar + denser grids.

workstation_dense.label: Workstation dense (trading desk / ops console)
workstation_dense.when: Real-time ledgers, order books, execution / audit trails, monitoring and ops consoles, fintech or HFT desks. Operator stares at it all day.

layout.shell: icon_rail (w-14, bg-foreground text-background, 6 solar icons, avatar bottom) + nav_column (w-56, grouped, text-tiny uppercase tracking-wider text-default-400 group labels, rows with right-aligned mono rate) + main
layout.header_strip: h1 text-medium font-semibold + one-line subtitle text-tiny text-default-500; right side: live Chip color=success variant=flat size=sm with pulsing dot, session Button variant=bordered size=sm radius=sm, kill switch Button color=danger variant=bordered size=sm radius=sm
layout.kpi_strip: one Card border-small border-default-200 shadow-none, 4 stats in a row, label text-tiny uppercase tracking-wider text-default-400, value text-medium font-semibold font-mono tabular-nums, semantic color on value (success / primary / danger)
layout.ledger_table: HeroUI Table isCompact removeWrapper, header text-tiny uppercase text-default-400, id cell font-mono text-primary, side cell BUY text-success / SELL text-danger font-semibold, status Chip size=sm variant=flat, selected row bg-primary-50 border-l-2 border-primary, hover bg-default-50
layout.inspector_panel: Card with selected row title (font-mono) + Chip, two-line summary, mini bar chart (bid rows success-200, ask rows danger-200, dashed center line), timeline rows from notification-item pattern: T+x.xx us font-mono text-primary, title font-semibold, one-line body text-tiny text-default-500, right Chip size=sm variant=bordered; footer two Buttons (primary variant=flat, secondary variant=bordered) both size=sm radius=sm
layout.radius: rounded-medium cards, radius=sm buttons, never radius=full

button_matrix_override.danger: color="danger" variant="bordered" size="sm" radius="sm" (kill switch, always visible top-right)
button_matrix_override.note: Dense exception: no pills. Everything size sm.

copy_rules: Every number carries its unit: us, ms, bps, $, %, /s
Fixed status vocabulary per domain, e.g. FILLED / ROUTED / PARTIAL / ACK; never invent synonyms
No marketing copy, no hero, no feature cards
Monospace + tabular-nums for every id, price, latency, timestamp
states: Empty ledger: single row 'No orders this session'
Feed offline: header live chip turns color=danger 'Feed offline'; kill switch stays
No selection: inspector shows 'Select an order' with text-default-400
Loading: Skeleton rows matching table row height, never a spinner over the whole screen
workstation_dense.notes: Reference: Sub-Millisecond Order Flow screenshot (icon rail, nav column, header strip, KPI strip, ledger, inspector with microsecond timeline). Theme still applies: Brutalism = 2px borders + mono everywhere, Glass = translucent panels over dark backdrop, Mouve = mauve selected row and chips.

chat_soft.label: Chat / AI soft product
chat_soft.when: Chat UIs that should still feel product-clean, not purple marketing
chat_soft.notes: Chat shell + pill send buttons; avoid full marketing heroes.

selection_rules: User says like Vault OTP / those cards / those buttons -> clean_product + read case-studies/vault-otp.md
Surface H (wallet_dapp) -> clean_product or trust_green only (never marketing_campaign)
Surface A landing -> marketing_campaign + case-studies/landing-and-desk.md; CTA to /desk; zero Connect on landing
Surface A section requests (testimonials, logos, team, faq, footer, banner) -> section_router entry + marketing_campaign; read that one file plus hero App for spacing
If product has landing AND work surface -> two routes; never jam; theme does not collapse the split
Surface D chat -> chat_soft (not random purple landing)
Surface F with real-time / terminal / desk / ledger / order book / monitoring keywords -> workstation_dense + case-studies/workstation-dense.md
Efficient: clean_product_core 3 files first; +1 route App only if needed; max 4
